sentence: This project studies how graph neural networks can work well on data where connected items are not similar.
This project uses machine learning that builds in known physics to uncover hidden properties of the ionosphere near the aurora.
This project uses computer simulations to study how heat moves through aerogels and how their structure relates to their physical properties.
This project builds virtual lab libraries for teaching cybersecurity of industrial control systems and information technology.
This project brings researchers together to discuss how statistics, mathematics and AI can pull reliable information out of images.
This project builds learning methods and tools that make reinforcement learning systems follow rules written in temporal logic.
This project develops computer methods that predict how light and matter combine in two-dimensional materials placed between two mirrors.
This project builds a software tool that checks mathematically whether artificial intelligence models for autonomous vehicles are safe.
This project builds a network of researchers that develops computational models of human behavior so intelligent machines can work safely with people.
This project studies how embryos remove proteins deposited in the egg by the mother, and how this removal is controlled during development.
This project gets an instrument that maps how chemical elements are spread across soil, sediment and rock at very small scales.
This project studies how changes in a protein that moves acetylcholine into nerve terminals affect its release and behavior in fruit flies.
This project builds experiments and a computational model to find out how heart muscle and coronary blood vessels work together to control blood flow.
